assessments.reasoning: When a read resolves to a local in the current function, its runtime binding at the point of the read determines whether it has a value. Reading it while unbound raises UnboundLocalError. A later assignment can establish local scope even though it has yet to execute.

limitations: Missing names and names affected by global or nonlocal declarations follow their applicable resolution rules.
